validation=json.loads((root/"benchmark_tools/results/native_fas_sampling_validation_20261010_v1.json").read_text())
@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def distribution(M,G,c):
 lo=max(0,c-M+G); hi=min(c,G); anchor=min(hi,max(lo,c*G//M))
 weights={anchor:Decimal(1)}
 for n in range(anchor,hi):
  weights[n+1]=weights[n]*Decimal((G-n)*(c-n))/Decimal((n+1)*(M-G-c+n+1))
 for n in range(anchor,lo,-1):
  weights[n-1]=weights[n]*Decimal(n*(M-G-c+n))/Decimal((G-n+1)*(c-n+1))
 total=sum(weights.values(),Decimal())
 assert total>0 and all(x>0 for x in weights.values())
 return weights,total
def weight(M,G,c,k):
 probabilities,total=distribution(M,G,c)
 return sum((p*Decimal(k)/Decimal(k+r) for r,p in probabilities.items()),Decimal())/total
def upper_tail(M,G,c,r):
 probabilities,total=distribution(M,G,c)
 return sum((p for n,p in probabilities.items() if n>=r),Decimal())/total
def lower_tail(M,G,c,r):
 probabilities,total=distribution(M,G,c)
 return sum((p for n,p in probabilities.items() if n<=r),Decimal())/total
def decimal_fraction(value):
 return Decimal(value.numerator)/Decimal(value.denominator)

 ctx.prec=80
 reference_error=Decimal(0)
 for config,row in zip(validation["plan"],validation["cells"]):

  muP=sum((n*Fraction(s) for n,s in config["pre"]),Fraction())/P
  muG=sum((n*Fraction(s) for n,s in config["missing"] if s is not None),Fraction())/G if G else Fraction()
  w=weight(M,G,config["c"],config["k"])
  point=w*decimal_fraction(muP)+(1-w)*decimal_fraction(muG)
  reference_error=max(reference_error,abs(point-decimal_fraction(Fraction(row["target_fraction"]))))

  assert row["observed_native_mean"]==raw["saved_mean"] and row["precomputed_population_mean"]==full["precomputed_mean"] and row["returned_sample_mean"]==raw["strata"]["missing"]["mean"]
  assert row["database_historically_hash_bound"]==full["database_historically_hash_bound"] is False
  muP=Decimal(str(full["precomputed_mean"])); muR=Decimal(str(raw["strata"]["missing"]["mean"]))
  observed=(Decimal(k)*Decimal(str(raw["strata"]["precomputed"]["mean"]))+Decimal(r)*muR)/Decimal(k+r)
  assert abs(observed-Decimal(str(row["observed_native_mean"])))<Decimal("1e-12")
  interval=row["interval"]; gl,gh=interval["success_count_bounds"]
  assert r<=gl<=gh<=M-c+r

  width=(Decimal(640).ln()/Decimal(2*r)).sqrt()

  assert interval["component_error"]==.05/16 and interval["method_error_bound"]==.05/8
  assert interval["target"]==report["target"]=="expected_native_post_attrition_ratio_under_fixed_design"
  endpoints[row["method"]]=expected
 for row,(left,right) in zip(report["contrasts"],combinations(report["methods"],2)):
